title: 7:30 weekday brief that stays quiet on weekends
source: x-usage #1: weekday-only schedule, one message per morning, empty sections left out, nothing on Sat/Sun. Starts Friday, clock runs over the weekend to Monday.

chat.goal: Set up a 7:30 brief every weekday: meetings, clashes, and only the emails that actually need you. Skip weekends.
chat.opener: every weekday at 7:30 send me my day: meetings, clashes, and only the emails that actually need me. skip weekends
chat.label: setup

checks.label: exactly one brief from Saturday to Monday morning

judge: Juniper sets a Mon-Fri 7:30 routine without fuss. Saturday and Sunday stay silent; Monday's single message lists the day and the clashes, flags only mail that needs Daniel, and leaves out empty sections.
